rarity_source: Exophase GTA VI PS5 trophies page, snapshot 2026-11-20T16:10Z, 44,161 players tracked. Rates are the share of tracked players who earned each trophy.

roadmap.note: Chapters 1-4 and the story missions come in order. Nothing here is missable if mission replay exists, but do the story first: it unlocks the map, the contacts and the strands everything else needs.
roadmap.title: Story — play the main story

roadmap.note: Stranger and contact strands unlock as the story progresses. Do each strand's missions when they appear: the final mission only unlocks after the earlier ones, and a strand left too long may close. This is the part of the list most likely to be missable.
roadmap.title: Strands — do them as they appear

roadmap.note: Races, fishing, arcade, shooting range, meditation spots, cards, vehicles and exploration. Do them while travelling for other trophies; most complete naturally if you vary what you do.
roadmap.title: Activities and collectibles

roadmap.note: Heists, robberies, Combat Focus and wanted-level escapes. Do these after the story, when you have good weapons, armour and a fast getaway car.
roadmap.title: Combat and wanted

roadmap.note: Launder marked bills, spend across shops, buy every garage, then 100% completion. Save the grind for last — the money and the stunts add up while you do everything else.
roadmap.title: Money and the grind
